supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show repeated failed logons for svc-render from FILE-NWD-01, using LogonType 3 and source address 10.40.20.20, at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:31 through 13:46 UTC.
The failures report incorrect-password status (SubStatus/Status 0xc000006a); domain-controller records also show failed credential validation for svc-render from FILE-NWD-01.

The timing and cadence are consistent with the known scheduled svc-render password rotation at 13:30 UTC followed by a job that re-authenticates every minute; stale credentials in the job are a plausible explanation for these failures.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided authentication records end at 13:46 UTC, so they do not establish what happened during the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The records identify lsass.exe as the authentication process but do not identify the application or service that supplied the credentials.
The supplied evidence does not include service configuration, password-rotation completion, or job-update records.
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-render password rotation completed successfully at 13:30 UTC or whether the RenderQueue job was updated afterward.
Whether the failed attempts continued, stopped, or were followed by successful authentication after 13:46 UTC.
Whether any person or unauthorized process initiated or altered the activity.
